spans.s:
n. (-क्षं)
1 Alms, what is collected by begging.
2 Begging, mendicancy.
E.
भिक्षा alms, given and received, aff. अण्; also भैक्ष्य.

n. (-णं)
Plying for alms, begging.
E.
भैक्ष, and चरण going.

f. (-र्य्या)
Begging, collecting alms.
E.
भैक्ष, and चर्य्या practice.

f. (-का)
Living upon alms, begging, mendicancy.
E.
भैक्ष aggregate alms, जीविका livelihood.

m. (-भुक्)
A mendicant.
E.
भैक्ष alms, and भुज् who subsists; also भैक्षाशिन्, भिक्षाशिन्, &c.

m. (-शी)
A mendicant.
E.
भैक्ष, and आशिन् who eats.

m. (-रः)
A mendicant, one living on charity.
E.
भैक्ष, and आहार food.

n. (-क्ष्यं)
Mendicity, begging.
E.
भिक्षा, and यञ् aff.
